ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which predator is atop this food chain?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, containing labels such as foxes, sheep, eagles, insects, Plants, rabbits, echidnas, mallee fowls, cats, etc. eagles is located toward the upper right of the diagram, and arrows point to eagles from lower or adjacent organisms. Reasoning: In a food chain/food web, arrows usually point from the organism being eaten to the predator. eagles, which is located above and receives arrows from other organisms, indicates the top predator. Therefore, the predator at the top of this food chain is eagle.
